description: The empty guide skeleton with guidance comments for each section. By default a task brief: Goal, Context, Constraints, Acceptance, Out of scope. `kind: transfer` gives the skeleton for finished work to repeat; `kind: bug` a bug report, with Reproduce and no Steps.

kind.description: task (default) for work nobody has done yet; transfer for finished work to repeat; bug for a defect to fix
